pattern: \bworktrees?\b|\b(in parallel|at the same time|concurrently)\b.*\b(agents?|sessions?|edit\w*|fix\w*)\b|\b(agents?|sessions?)\b.*\b(in parallel|at the same time|concurrently)\b|\b(overwrote|overwritten|clobber\w*|stomped)\b|\bsame (file|checkout|branch|tree)\b
say: [isolated-dispatch] Every agent that edits files gets its own worktree and its own branch; never two agents on one file. Check the tree is clean and the tests are green before dispatching. Each agent pushes its branch after its first commit; you do the merges. Load the isolated-dispatch skill.

[isolated-dispatch] Changes in the tree that you did not make are someone's work. Read them (`git diff`, `git log`) before anything else; never stash, reset, or check out over them. Name the branch you are on before a commit, merge or push. Load the isolated-dispatch skill.
